name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl
description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chernobyl is a singleplayer and multiplayer open-world first-person shooter and survival horror game and the first in the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. series.

eax.problem: Stalker's X-Ray engine supports EAX via OpenAL.However, very few of it's maps actually contain environmental audio.
eax.fix: A community patch is available that adds environmental effects to the game's levels.

optional_settings.title: Remove head bob.
optional_settings.reason: The game's default setting has a rather aggressive head bob, this may make some users feel uncomfortable.
